يعتلون (form VIII)
# يَعْتَلُونَ (yaʕtalūna) /jaʕ.ta.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
# يُعْتَلَوْنَ (yuʕtalawna) /juʕ.ta.law.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
